note: Decree 25-320 (2025-12-30) sets up a data governance scheme with a data classification referentiel and a data source cataloguing referentiel (to be drawn up and published by the High Commission, not yet published) and an exchange system; no technical exchange standards (formats, codes, interfaces, protocols) are stated, and the two referentiels cover classification and cataloguing, so no fact.
Statistics-sector quality framework (QAF, CoP, GSBPM, preliminary alignment with international metadata standards); no government-wide technical standards for exchange between systems, so no fact.

Decree creating the digitisation high commissariat; it only cites executive decree 19-271 of 2019 on the national interoperability referential in its visas and says nothing of what that referential sets, so no fact.
The arrêté asks the procurement system to adopt interoperability standards but names no set of technical standards and says nothing of their content.
